Alex — sorry for the delay, putting the policy details inline so you have everything in one place. High level first, then operational notes: 

Policy summary (hosted API default)
- Default retention window for full request/response (prompt + model output + request metadata) on Hosted API: 30 days.
- Data is encrypted at rest and in transit. For EU-region projects, persisted logs are stored in-region (EU) by default.
- Short-lived runtime artifacts (KV cache, active model state) are ephemeral and not part of persisted request/response logs.

Operational details / options
- Opt-outs: Customers on Enterprise plans can request "no-persist" for prompt/output (we will not write request/response bodies to long-term storage) or shorter retention (7 days) during provisioning.
- Console/API controls: The Console exposes a per-project retention selector (7 / 30 / 90 days) for Hosted customers on Enterprise/Dedicated. There is also an API endpoint for on-demand purge: POST /v1/retention/purge (documented in our admin API).
- Deletion propagation: Purges remove indexed and blob data from primary stores within 72 hours; backup snapshots may still retain encrypted copies for up to 90 days for disaster recovery. We document this window in the DPA and our SOC2 Notes.

Edge cases and clarifications
- Billing and fraud telemetry: Aggregated billing meters and fraud-detection signals are retained for 12 months (aggregated, not raw prompt/output).
- Audit logs: Administrative audit trails (who did what in the Console) are retained per customer policy; default is 365 days.
- Embeddings: If you use the embeddings endpoint, we retain vectors for 90 days by default (separate from prompt/output).

Next steps we recommend for FinServCo
1) If residency is required: sign the DPA + select EU-hosted project and we will ensure persisted request/response logs are stored in EU-only storage.
2) If minimal retention is required: we can provision a "no-persist" Enterprise flag for the project or configure 7-day retention.
3) For immediate purge requests: send a signed purge request via the security mailbox (security@redwood.ai) and we'll execute the purge and ack within 72 hours; we'll include a purge report and the retention-summary CSV.

I'll attach a short one-pager and the retention CSV for your procurement team. Priya / Neha — please add any security/legal caveats.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Redwood Inference

Adding security/legal context from our side — important caveats for procurement/security review:

- Backups & disaster recovery: As Marissa noted, purge operations remove live and indexed copies quickly, but immutable backups and cross-region replication may retain encrypted blobs for up to 90 days in rare recovery windows. We provide a documented SLA in the DPA describing this behavior.
- BYOK / KMS: For Enterprise and Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (BYOK) so you can rotate/revoke keys independent of Redwood; revoking a key renders backups inaccessible.
- Forensic & legal holds: If a customer places a legal hold or we are served with legal process, retention may be extended as required by law; we notify customers with the process outlined in the DPA.
- Redaction tooling: We offer optional automated PII redaction in transit for hosted projects (token classification hooks). Redaction reduces the amount of sensitive data written to logs but is not enabled by default. Enablement is part of Enterprise onboarding.
- Data residency attestation: We provide formal attestation for EU-only residency when customers select EU-hosted projects and sign the DPA+Annex.

If FinServCo wants, we can provide a short lab exercise where you send a sample sanitized request and we demonstrate the purge workflow and provide logs showing deletion timestamps.

—Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Alex — thanks for the questions and for the packet. Summary and next steps below (short format your procurement team can use):

Summary (what we retain by default on Hosted API)
- Full request/response (prompt + output + metadata): 30 days default. EU projects persist data to EU-only storage.
- Runtime KV cache / transient model state: not persisted to long-term logs.
- Embeddings: retained 90 days by default (separate control).
- Billing meters & aggregated telemetry: retained 12 months.
- Audit logs: 365 days default.

Options for FinServCo (Enterprise onboarding)
- Residency + DPA: we will enable EU-only persistence and provide attestation.
- Minimal retention: enable "no-persist" or 7-day retention.
- Redaction: enable automated PII redaction before persistence.
- BYOK: customer-managed keys available to limit access to persisted blobs.
- Purge API: we will execute on-demand purges and provide a report; full propagation typically completes within 72 hours (backups up to 90 days).

Requested next steps from FinServCo
1) Please confirm target account type (Hosted Enterprise / Dedicated / Private).
2) If Hosted Enterprise, sign the DPA + Annex for EU residency and indicate desired retention (no-persist / 7 / 30 / 90).
3) If helpful, we can run the purge demo with a sanitized sample — let us know a preferred time next week.

I'll attach the CSV retention summary and the completed questionnaire with our answers. Let me know if you'd like us to loop legal to draft precise contract language for the clause about backup retention windows.
